title: Auditory Cortex Mapping Dataset
description: A single-subject MEG and MRI dataset for demonstrating an MEG-based auditory cortex mapping technique. The participant passively listened to 1795 iso-intensity pure tones spanning 100 Hz to about 21.5 kHz in quarter-octave steps while fixating on a cross. The dataset includes empty-room recordings, head-shape digitization, and anatomical MRI processed with FreeSurfer.
methods_description: MEG was recorded with a CTF 275 system (340 channels including reference sensors, axial gradiometers, ECG and EOG) at the Montreal Neurological Institute. A single run of about 653 s was recorded at 12000 Hz with a 3000 Hz anti-aliasing filter and 3rd order gradient compensation. Binaural stimuli were delivered via intra-aural earphones and generated with the Matlab Psychophysics toolbox at an average presentation rate of 3 Hz. Head points and fiducials were digitized with a Polhemus Fastrak, and anatomy was acquired with 1.5T MRI and processed with FreeSurfer 5.3.
